batteryInstructionsBody:
To ensure location tracking works when your screen is off:

1. Go to Settings > Apps > [This App]
2. Tap on 'Battery' or 'Power'
3. Select 'Battery Optimization' or 'Unrestricted'
4. Find this app and set it to 'Not optimized' or 'Don't optimize'

Note: Steps may vary slightly depending on your device manufacturer.
